description: A complex C++ source file implementing a process/thread tracing tool using ptrace, handling system calls, process/thread creation and termination, file operations, and generating an HTML report of file accesses.

classes.name: ProcessType
classes.description: Enum class to distinguish between process and thread types.

classes.name: ThreadInfo
classes.description: Structure to store information about a thread or process, including IDs, name, activity status, parent, children, creation time, and exit status.

classes.name: FileOperation
classes.description: Structure to store details of a file operation, including process ID, file path, sequence number, thread ID, thread name, and whether it is an actual open.

methods.name: handle_thread_creation
methods.description: Handles creation of a new thread or process, updating thread map and parent-child relationships.

methods.name: handle_thread_exit
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a thread or process exits, including recursive cleanup of children and ptrace detachment.

methods.name: resolve_fd_path
methods.description: Resolves the file descriptor path for a given process and fd.

methods.name: resolve_relative_path
methods.description: Resolves relative paths based on a base directory.

methods.name: read_process_string
methods.description: Safely reads a null-terminated string from a process's memory using ptrace.

methods.name: handle_syscall_entry
methods.description: Processes system call entry events, handling process/thread creation, exit, and file operations.

methods.name: generate_html_output
methods.description: Generates an HTML report of file operations using DirectoryTree and HtmlGenerator.

methods.name: validate_output_file
methods.description: Validates that the output file path is writable and the directory exists.

methods.name: validate_command
methods.description: Checks if the specified command exists and is executable.

methods.name: display_help
methods.description: Displays help message with usage examples.
